title: Cipher
description: Twenty-five codewords, two teams and one phone. A hidden key marks nine words red, eight blue, seven bystanders and one assassin. Each team's spymaster gives one word and one number; their operatives arm a codeword and confirm the contact. The key is never on screen unheld — every turn opens with the phone shuttered closed and a pass instruction, and the key appears only while a finger is held on the fingerprint pad, gone the frame it lifts. Printed like a 1960s dossier: card stock, stencil ink and a turning sunburst, with every codeword set twice so both sides of the table read the grid the right way up.
